div.head: II As 22.2
div.ab: ⁊ nan man ne getæce his getyhtledan men fram him, ær he hæbbe riht geworhte.
⁊ non mon ne tæce his getihtledan mon from him, ær he hæbbe ryht geworht.
⁊ nan … tyhtledan men fram, ær he hæbbe ryht …
Et nemo suum hominem accusatum a se dimittat, donec rectum (per omnia) faciat.
⁊ non mon ne tæce his getihtledan mon from him, ær he hæbbe ryht geworht.
And no one shall send away one of his men, if he has been accused, before the man has complied with the demands of the law.
And no one is to dismiss his man who has been accused, before he has rendered justice.
Und niemand weise seinen verklagten Untergebenen von sich, bevor dieser Rechtspflicht erfüllt hat.
And let no one dismiss his accused dependant from him before that man has fulfilled his legal obligation.
